records_outside_main.name: TSBench
records_outside_main.reason: A benchmark-contained LLM structure-editing/diagnosis agent is demonstrated, but it is not separately counted as a named general research system in the main counting unit. This is a counting choice, not a claim that it performs no computations.
records_outside_main.positive_evidence: Agent constructs 3D TS guesses and revises them using quantum-chemical failure diagnosis.
records_outside_main.sensitivity: Including the environment gives N=27: extended materials/surfaces 14, finite molecular 10, soft/biomolecular 3.

records_outside_main.name: ARplorer
records_outside_main.locator: Updated main text: Chemical logic, paragraphs immediately before Fig.3; author correction linked on journal page
records_outside_main.reason: The updated article explicitly restricts the LLM to initial literature mining/knowledge curation; PES exploration, energy evaluation and ranking are deterministic/QM. No LLM computational execution/feedback decisions are demonstrated.

records_outside_main.name: ToPolyAgent
records_outside_main.reason: Discovery result indicates LLM-orchestrated polymer MD, potentially eligible. Primary page returned HTTP 403; no definitive classification or main-denominator inclusion made.

records_outside_main.name: Multi-agentic AI framework for end-to-end atomistic simulations
records_outside_main.reason: Potentially eligible MD system; primary page returned HTTP 403. Distinct system identity and duplication with related MD systems were not resolved.

records_outside_main.name: MatAgent (Lv et al.)
records_outside_main.reason: ChemGraph reference 31 points to a PWDFT materials tool agent. Original report and demonstrated tasks were not checked in this first sample; no negative or exclusion judgment is assigned.

records_outside_main.name: DynaMate
records_outside_main.reason: Discovered as a cited modular molecular-simulation agent; primary identity, publication date and demonstrated targets remain to be checked.

records_outside_main.name: AutoSolvateWeb
records_outside_main.reason: A chatbot-driven explicit-solvation platform was identified. Discovery sources describe the chatbot as mainly rules based; no original LLM-in-the-loop execution claim was verified, so it is not silently treated as an eligible LLM system.

generic_scope_exclusions: Pure chemistry QA without execution of atomistic calculation
Property predictors and molecular/crystal generators without agent-run atomistic calculations
Wet-experiment agents without demonstrated computational chemistry/atomistic workflows
